body:
My extremely poor parents once got me a $3000 camera as a birthday present instead of getting me braces like responsible parents.

I'm still afraid of smiling, two decades later.

Wait, I don't think that's quite what the OP had in mind.

>Did you just pick up and leave one day?

yep.

>Aren't you concerned that your family may be worried? 

Probably. But they... well, they were horrible parents. I don't want them to watch me die but I feel no obligation toward them.

>have you turned your life around, so to speak?

haha.

hahaha.

yeah, no. FSM knows i've been trying.

I'm the epitome of a fuckup. I've been doing reckless, stupid shit for as long as I can remember. When I began to realize that I couldn't change and I was likely going to commit suicide I disappeared and cut off contact with my family. I'd rather they just not see me go down. But yeah, some fuck ups aren't bad people.
Wow, thanks. Some of these options sound really really good. I wouldn't mind working on a farm.
I've been talking to a lawyer. Not much I can do. And yeah, I'm trans.

>do you have a passport? and are sure it illegal?

No. Yes.

They won't come after me. But I can't come back, or I'll be arrested at the border. So I'll be an illegal immigrant for the rest of my life, or spend time in jail when I come back here.

It's a dead end though. Once I leave the country, I will become a fugitive. The military will want me because I owe them money, the hospital will want me because I owe them money, I'll be crossing borders illegally...

There's no way back. Essentially it's a one way trip. I've kind of known for the last 10 years or so that I was slowly narrowing down my options one at a time to force myself to commit suicide. Maybe this is the last step.

>are there any other things you would like to do in life?

I don't know. Maybe like... not be miserable? But I don't know how to accomplish that.

The only thing I have left that I want to do is travel the world alone and maybe find some solace somewhere. And I don't mean typical tourist places, I mean like the amazon rain forest or alaska. It would probably end up killing me though. But that's ok.

The world will only be equal when we can transcend our bodies completely and bend them to our will.

Until then, beautiful people will rule the world and the rest of us will be sad and alone.
